answer: In a decentralized AI consensus network, the use of beacon-based signaling mechanisms can effectively resist fake-identity attacks. By having each agent emit a unique beacon signal upon reaching a consensus, a malicious agent attempting to create multiple identities (Sybil attack) would struggle to maintain a consistent signal without being detected. If an attacker accumulates too much "timber" of compromised identities, their signal will become unstable, causing the network to reject their beacon and ultimately leading to their expulsion.
